crosswalks.historical_boundary: Multi-province Japan screen; individual Buzen, Noto and other province polygons are mapped in earlier packets.
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: high for earlier individual province crosswalks; not applicable to screen aggregate
crosswalks.resolution_method: No new aggregate mapping is created. Reuse the existing CHGIS-to-EU5 province crosswalks only for the earlier one-sided Farris floors.
crosswalks.notes: A broad Japan selector cannot be treated as the boundary of any one register or food system.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Fayyum depression and approximately one hundred village/hamlet units surveyed in 1245.
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: high for source village concept; low for EU5 equivalence
crosswalks.resolution_method: Do not map the whole EU5 Egypt region. Reconstruct village polygons from the QMU GIS maps before considering any quantitative aggregate; until then use only physical water/crop features.
crosswalks.notes: No total population interval exists, so even a future geometric crosswalk would remain validation-only until saturation evidence is found.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Fayyum province/depression as reconstructed from al-Nabulusi's 1243-1245 village register; Rapoport's approximately 75,000 total includes an approximately 5,000-person Madinat al-Fayyum urban component.
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: medium for historical reconstruction; low EU5 equivalence
crosswalks.resolution_method: Reconstruct the village polygons from the QMU GIS maps and explicitly remove/partition Madinat al-Fayyum before mapping. Until that is done, no aggregate target is admitted.
crosswalks.notes: The point estimate is valuable for validation and for auditing the mechanistic Fayyum result, but missing geometry and uncertainty keep it out of training.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Pingjiang Lu six Yuan counties around Suzhou in 1290.
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: medium administrative description; low EU5 equivalence
crosswalks.resolution_method: Do not equate the modern Suzhou location/province selector with six Yuan counties. Reconstruct the historical county polygons and remove urban/trade-hub boundary distortions before any aggregate use.
crosswalks.notes: The 2,433,700 value remains a validation point only; no saturation interval is available.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Archaeological Otrar oasis, approximately 200 km2, containing ten walled towns and fifty villages.
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: high for archaeological oasis; low EU5 equivalence
crosswalks.resolution_method: Digitize the archaeological oasis/canal footprint and intersect it with calibrated EU5 polygons; do not use the whole provisional province selector.
crosswalks.notes: The city/trade-hub rule and absence of saturation evidence block training even after geometric reconstruction.

crosswalks.resolution_method: Use canal/drainage evidence as physical constraints only. No aggregate boundary or population target is admitted.
crosswalks.notes: Broad Iraq-area matching would silently introduce national/administrative extrapolation.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Indus basin and Punjab/Sindh plains; no closed 1200-1350 rural boundary.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Keep irrigation/agrarian sources as technology and physical inputs. Reject basin-scale population extrapolation until a mappable local aggregate with independent pressure evidence is found.
